# L2-BPMN — inside a BPMN file

Knowledge-graph layer L2-bpmn as a NAMED SUBGRAPH of this layer, OPT-IN like `L1/` (a downstream layer lists `smart-base.smart-base-L2-bpmn` in its `enableSubgraphs`), beside `L1/` (owner, 2026-11-13: 'L1..L3 as named subgraphs', issue #359). `L2-bpmn/graph.json` names what it holds FROM WITHIN: its `schemas/` and, as they move in, its tools, skills and processes. It imports only from the layers below it.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-L2-bpmn`, holding `cat-harness`.
